_note: The sim's functions and their I/O. `knobs` = the editable cfg inputs a formula READS; `writes` = the schema columns it mutates. `reverse_index` inverts it: for each state column, which functions update it (the 'how it's updated' map).

formulas.expr: cap = (warehouse_lvl + 1) * warehouse_cap_base
formulas.note: Per-good storage cap; production over the cap spoils.
formulas.title: Warehouse capacity per good

formulas.expr: sol% = clamp( rebel_A * 100 / rebel_B , 0 .. 100 )   ; 0 when rebel_B <= 0
formulas.note: Rebel sentiment as a percent of accumulated bell support (A=dividend, B=divisor).
formulas.title: Sons-of-Liberty percentage

formulas.expr: B -= B >> sol_decay_shift   (floor 1) ; then  B += sol_inflow_mult * population
formulas.note: 1/64 exponential decay (shift 6) plus a per-colonist inflow each turn.
formulas.title: SoL membership divisor

formulas.expr: A += bells_this_turn - (A >> sol_decay_shift) ; clamp A to [0, B]
formulas.note: Bells raise rebel sentiment; the same 1/64 decay pulls it back down.
formulas.title: SoL bell accumulator

formulas.expr: tory = (population*(100-sol%) + 50)/100 ; div = human ? (tory_divisor_base - difficulty) : tory_divisor_base  (floor 1) ; y -= tory/div ; if expert: era-good y += expert_era_bonus else y *= expert_mfg_mult ; y = max(y,0)
formulas.note: Loyalists (Tories) cut output; experts add a flat era bonus or multiply manufactured goods.
formulas.title: Tory penalty + expert bonus on a tile yield

formulas.expr: food_accum += food_per_turn ; if food_accum >= food_growth_threshold and population < max_population: population += 1 ; food_accum -= food_growth_threshold ; rebel_B += sol_birth_bonus
formulas.note: A new colonist is born once stored food crosses the threshold; surplus carries over.
formulas.title: Population growth on stored food

formulas.expr: accumulate hammers into hammers_accum and build_bank ; when build_cost <= both, build_bank -= build_cost and the building/unit completes (surplus carried)
formulas.note: build_cost is per-building/unit data (@BUILDING/@UNIT), not a global knob.
formulas.title: Construction from hammers

systems.name: Economy - Sons of Liberty, tax, growth, building

formulas.expr: supply[g] = price_base[g] + SUM over 4 powers of max(trade[p][g], 0)
formulas.note: price_base is the hidden supply accumulator (seeded rng 600..1000 per market.md); trade (+0xFC) is this turn's net volume: SELL adds, BUY subtracts. What you sell builds the visible supply; what you buy draws it down.
formulas.title: Hidden supply per good

formulas.expr: S_pair = clamp( supply[Rum]+supply[Cigars]+supply[Cloth]+supply[Coats], >=1 ) ; level[g] = clamp( S_pair*3 / supply[g], @CARGO.drift_low .. drift_high )   for g in {Sugar..Furs, Rum..Coats}
formulas.note: One shared pool couples the four finished goods and their raws: dumping Rum raises Cigars/Cloth/Coats. Furs supply is halved; +1 if year<1700 and +1 more if <1600 (attach point RECONSTRUCTED).
formulas.title: Pool price level (finished goods + their raws)

formulas.expr: bid = max(level - 1, 0) ; ask = bid + @CARGO.burden + 1
formulas.note: USER RULING: the bid/ask spread is the per-good Burden column in NAMES.TXT @CARGO (Food 7, Sugar 1, finished goods 0 -> spread 1).
formulas.title: Published prices

formulas.expr: gross = bid*qty ; tax_cut = gross*tax%/100 ; gold += gross - tax_cut ; royal_money += tax_cut ; trade[g] += qty ; recompute ; Dutch (nation 3) SELL pool delta x2/3 (national_powers.md, func_03234A @0x32390)
formulas.note: The tax cut funds the King's REF treasury (king.md:92 -- taxes pay for the Royal Expeditionary Force). Gold clamps to 0..999999.
formulas.title: Sell to Europe (taxed)

formulas.expr: gold -= ask*qty ; trade[g] -= qty ; recompute
formulas.note: Buying is untaxed and collapses the hidden supply, pushing the price back up.
formulas.title: Buy from Europe (untaxed)

formulas.expr: price_drift ; market_recompute ; zero trade[] for all powers
formulas.note: Drift then republish then reset the per-turn volume (the zero order is RECONSTRUCTED).
formulas.title: Per-turn market phase

formulas.expr: for each good: acc = price_base + SUM over 4 powers of max(trade,0) ; price_base -= acc >> price_drift_shift
formulas.note: Selling pushes a good's hidden supply (and so its price) down proportionally (>>8 = /256 each turn); buys (negative volume) are ignored by the drift.
formulas.title: Per-good supply decay from net sales

formulas.expr: on sell: level -= 1 ; on buy: level += 1 ; clamp to @CARGO.drift_low .. drift_high
formulas.note: Goods outside the pool (Food, Silver, Horses, Trade Goods, Tools, Muskets) move by +/-1 steppers per transaction (steppers byte-cited; the exact driver is RECONSTRUCTED).
formulas.title: Non-pool goods price movement

systems.name: Market - the European commodity market (hidden supply, pool pricing, tax)

formulas.expr: P(attacker wins) = atk_str / (atk_str + def_str)   ; 0 when total is 0
formulas.note: Pure ATK/(ATK+DEF) odds -- the classic Colonization combat model.
formulas.title: Probability the attacker wins

formulas.expr: atk = unit.attack (+difficulty_bonus if human attacker) ; def = unit.defense + terrain_defense + fort_bonus (+difficulty_bonus if human defender) ; clamp both >= 0 ; if fortified: def = def * fortify_def_num / fortify_def_den
formulas.note: Terrain defense comes from the editable terrain_defense table; fortify adds +50% (3/2).
formulas.title: Attack/defense strength build-up

formulas.expr: roll = rng(1, atk_str + def_str) ; attacker_won = (roll <= atk_str)
formulas.note: A single uniform roll over the combined strength decides the fight.
formulas.title: The combat die

formulas.expr: Soldiers->Colonists ; Dragoons->Soldiers ; Cont.Cavalry->Cont.Army ; Cavalry->Regulars ; Cont.Army->Colonists ; (Missionary loser of a ->Colonists step becomes Missionaries) ; anything else -> destroyed
formulas.note: Fixed structural ladder (unit type ids) -- a code wall, not data.
formulas.title: Loser demotion ladder

formulas.expr: capturable = loser is Colonists, Treasure, or Wagon Train  (taken intact by the winner)
formulas.note: Fixed structural set -- a code wall, not data.
formulas.title: Units that change hands instead of dying

formulas.expr: with George Washington (FF 11): automatic ; else promote iff random_int(1, S) <= winner_strength  (P = winner_strength / S) ; non-veteran soldier-line -> Veteran stamp (0x15) ; veteran at the ceiling: Soldiers(1) -> Continental Army(9), Dragoons(4) -> Continental Cavalry(7)
formulas.note: @0x5C758 Washington gate, @0x5C764 roll, @0x5C7C3/@0x5C7CE type advance, @0x5C7DD class write. The losing side runs the existing demotion ladder (func_05B2C2).
formulas.title: Veteran promotion on a combat win

formulas.expr: bonus = colony +2 (@0x7D8D) + fortified-building(level>=2) +4 (@0x7DBC, x2 under the 0x20 condition @0x7DD1) + river/road (n+1)*2 (@0x7E12) + @TERRAIN Defensive (@0x7E63) ; applied to the defending strength as strength*(bonus+4)/4 then *3/2 (@0x05CE05/@0x05CE16)
formulas.note: Applied only when a bonus exists: the trace's unconditional *3/2 is ambiguous about which strength local it scales -- gating on bonus>0 keeps unmodified engagements identical (RECONCILIATION note in combat.hpp).
formulas.title: Defense-bonus chain (func_007D3E + func_05CA7E)

formulas.expr: raw @UNIT Guns/Hull pair (0x523B/0x523C), NO land modifiers (@0x05B819) ; roll = random_int(1, A+D) (@0x05B844), attacker wins iff roll <= A ; loser laden (the +0x3148&0x40 cargo bit @0x05BD1E) -> SUNK with cargo ; empty -> DAMAGED (@SHIPDAMAGE)
formulas.note: Only Privateers and Frigates can attack enemy ships (@SHIPCOMBAT verbatim; the Man-O-War fights on the King's side). The damaged ship's repair voyage is not modeled -- it survives with its move spent.
formulas.title: Ship-vs-ship roll (func_05B2C2 ship path)

formulas.expr: strength = artillery_count * fort_level * 4 (count starts 1, +1 per Artillery in the colony @0x02D432; level = +1 stockade +1 fort, the 0x181F:0x9FC queries) ; no fortification -> no fire (@0x02D44D) ; DETERMINISTIC -- no random thunk in the function ; one adjacent enemy ship per colony per turn ; emits @FORTFIRE
formulas.note: Damage-vs-sink in the EXE is the opaque owner-bit test [bp-6] (@0x02D530) -- RECONSTRUCTED as sunk iff strength >= the ship's Hull stat.
formulas.title: Fort fire on adjacent ships (func_02D3C6)

formulas.expr: regulars  = ref_regulars_scale*d  + ref_regulars_offset ; cavalry   = ref_cavalry_scale*d   + ref_cavalry_offset ; manowar   = ref_manowar_scale*d   + ref_manowar_offset ; artillery = ref_artillery_scale*d + ref_artillery_offset
formulas.note: The King's army at game start scales with the difficulty level.
formulas.title: Starting REF size by difficulty d

formulas.expr: rate = ref_accrue_scale*d + ref_accrue_offset ; then for each gate year in ref_accrue_gate_years with year >= gate: rate *= 2
formulas.note: The King saves faster as the game advances (doubles at each gate year).
formulas.title: Royal treasury growth per turn

formulas.expr: while royal_money >= ref_unit_cost: if regulars+2 > ref_cavalry_ratio*cavalry -> +1 cavalry ; else if regulars > ref_artillery_ratio*artillery -> +1 artillery ; else if (regulars+cavalry+artillery+5) > ref_naval_ratio*manowar -> +1 man-o-war ; else +1 regular ; royal_money -= ref_unit_cost
formulas.note: Buys to keep target ratios of cavalry/artillery/ships to regulars.
formulas.title: Spending the treasury on new REF units

formulas.expr: set on a Tea Party: |= 1<<good (@0x34717) ; tested by ALL sell logic (func_030B38 -- the auto-sell loop @0x41210, the interactive sell @0x415A6, and the trade-route Europe leg) ; lift: back_tax = current price x 500 (@0x333AF imul 0x1F4), paid treasury -> the King's REF fund (@0x3340C), then &= ~(1<<good) (@0x33423); unaffordable -> not lifted (@0x333DD) ; Jakob Fugger (FF 1) clears the whole mask (@0x3BD45)
formulas.note: The interactive sell of a boycotted good opens the verbatim @KISSUP pay-or-abort dialog; there is NO passive boycott glyph in the trade list (byte-decidably none -- no render path reads the bit, boycotts.md 4).
formulas.title: Tea Party boycotts (+0x20 bitmask)

formulas.expr: tax_pct hard-clamped at 75 on the raise write (func_034318 @0x03434F cmp 0x4B) ; 60 (0x3C) is an independent message gate (func_0349F4 @0x034A1B), not the cap
formulas.title: Tax gates (60 message gate / 75 hard clamp)

systems.name: REF / the King - the Royal Expeditionary Force

formulas.expr: post-independence: cost = difficulty*ff_post_indep_scale + ff_post_indep_offset ; otherwise base = human ? (difficulty+ff_human_offset)*ff_human_scale : (ff_ai_offset-difficulty)*ff_ai_scale ; for each gate in ff_gate_years with year>=gate: cost += cost >> ff_compounding_shift  (x1.5) ; cost = (ff_count+1)*cost + 1 ; if ff_count==0: cost >>= ff_first_father_shift  (half price)
formulas.note: Each father costs more than the last; later eras compound it; the first is half price.
formulas.title: Bells (or gold) to recruit the next father

formulas.note: Fixed era cutoffs (code) used to weight which fathers appear.
formulas.title: Era band for father weighting

formulas.expr: offerable = any father not yet owned  (next pick is a weighted random over all un-owned)
formulas.note: Byte-verified: no intra-category ordering gate -- simply un-acquired.
formulas.title: Which fathers may be offered

formulas.expr: a = total_workers + unit_count ; if a < imm_threshold_cap: a = a*imm_sub4k_mult + imm_sub4k_offset ; cap a at imm_threshold_cap ; if AI: a = a*(imm_ai_scale - difficulty)/imm_ai_divisor ; if player 0 (England): a = a*imm_england_num/imm_england_den
formulas.note: More colonists raise the bar; England immigrates faster (x2/3).
formulas.title: Crosses needed for the next immigrant

formulas.expr: crosses_accum += crosses_gained ; if crosses_accum > threshold: spawn a Free Colonist at dock slot rng(0, imm_dock_slots-1) ; crosses_accum = 0
formulas.note: When accumulated crosses pass the threshold, a recruit appears in a random dock slot.
formulas.title: Spawning an immigrant on the dock

formulas.expr: 1) production: every colony runs colony_economic_step ; 2) market: price_drift once ; 3) immigration: each of 4 powers, crosses = imm_base_crosses + SUM of its colonies' crosses_output ; 4) REF: human player's royal_money += accrue rate, then ref_purchase ; 5) units: refresh_moves then apply_orders (all owners) ; 6) advance_cadence
formulas.note: Fixed phase sequence; only the base-crosses scalar is a knob.
formulas.title: Order of operations each turn

formulas.expr: turn += 1 ; if year < 1600: year += 1  (1 turn = 1 year) ; else season = (season+1) mod 2, and year += 1 when season wraps to 0  (2 seasons/year)
formulas.note: Fixed calendar: yearly turns before 1600, two seasons per year after.
formulas.title: Calendar advance

formulas.expr: moves_left = unit.movement   (per unit type)
formulas.note: Movement allowance is per-unit data (@UNIT movement column).
formulas.title: Move points restored each turn

formulas.expr: greedy step = sign(target - pos) on each axis ; if that tile is off-map or wrong land/water -> find_step routes around it ; enemy occupant -> combat ; friendly -> blocked ; entering a tile costs terrain_move[id] (floor 1), but a unit always moves at least one tile
formulas.note: Greedy stepping with Dijkstra fallback; entry cost comes from the editable terrain_move table.
formulas.title: Executing a move order

formulas.expr: Dijkstra over passable tiles (passable = naval flag matches Ocean/Sea-Lane), 8-connected, edge cost = terrain_move[id] ; returns the first step of the least-cost route, or none
formulas.note: Routes a unit around coastlines/obstacles toward its target.
formulas.title: Obstacle-routing pathfinder

formulas.expr: attacker vs the occupant (defender fortified if its order is FORTIFY) ; loser is captured, destroyed, or demoted in place ; attacking sets attacker moves_left = 0
formulas.note: Wraps resolve_land for unit-vs-unit encounters during movement.
formulas.title: Combat triggered by a move

systems.name: Units & movement - orders, routing, terrain cost

formulas.expr: threshold = tribe_level + 2 ; if Jesuit: threshold *= 2 ; converts when rng(0..15) < threshold ; probability = threshold / 15
formulas.note: Code-side native formulas (literals; not in the cfg block).
formulas.title: Mission conversion chance

formulas.expr: if delta>0: halve if a French power, halve again if Pocahontas ; tension = clamp(tension + delta, 0 .. 100)
formulas.note: French diplomacy and the Pocahontas father each soften provocations.
formulas.title: Native tension update

formulas.expr: p = max(5*difficulty + 50, 2*tax_pct) ; cap p at 90
formulas.note: Code-side; rises with difficulty and your tax rate, capped at 90%.
formulas.title: Native trade price percent

formulas.expr: hi = min(3*settlement_wealth + 10, 100) ; gold = clamp(demand, 10 .. hi)
formulas.note: Code-side bounds on a tribute demand.
formulas.title: Gold a native demand resolves to

formulas.expr: tension[settlement][power] += delta, clamped [0,100] ; positive deltas HALVED for the French power (@0x45E21) and again for Pocahontas (FF 16, @0x45E30) ; thresholds: 75 hostile (@0x45E9E), 100 war (@0x45EB2) ; per-action deltas: trespass +1/+2/+3, trade -4, mission clamp <=70, incite +/-100, desecration +100 (@0x61B84)
formulas.note: The 0x5B1C meter is a PARALLEL signal from the alarm[] words (threshold 128). The EXE's 4th 'category' arg is dead -- never read by the applier (2026-06-27 reseg).
formulas.title: Tension meter (func_045DF2)

formulas.expr: gate = random_int(1,12)-1 (+(diff-2) vs a human target @0x5BF1A) vs 3*K+1 (@0x5BEE5; K RECONSTRUCTED = colony fort level) ; base outcome random_int(1,4) (@0x5BF35), -1 while turn < 40*(2-diff) (@0x5BF44) ; ladder (@0x5C026): 0 @RAIDNOTHING / 1 @RAIDSTORES (wealth +25 @0x5C3E4) / 2 @RAIDWREAK / 3 @RAIDGOLD / 4 @RAIDBURN|@RAIDSHIP
formulas.note: Stolen-goods share, gold share, and the burn target are RECONSTRUCTED (the keys + ladder + wealth bump are byte-cited).
formulas.title: Raid outcomes (func_05BE84)

formulas.expr: threshold = @TRIBES.level + 2, DOUBLED with Jean de Brebeuf (FF 0x16, @0x48C81) ; roll = random_int(0,15) ; converts iff roll < threshold (@0x57316) => P = (level+2)/15 ; the convert joins the colony as class 0x1B (@0x57374)
formulas.title: Mission conversion (func_0572E6)

formulas.expr: buy offer = min(90, max(5*diff+50, 2*tax)) (@0x5C976..@0x5C9A3) ; successful trade: tension -4 (@0x5C41E) ; raze gold = (sum of 3 x rng(0,10-diff)) * rng(0,6) * 4 * (level+1), credited directly (@0x4AAD0..@0x4AB66, no x100, no treasure unit)
formulas.title: Trade price + CHIEFKILL treasure

formulas.expr: war/peace toggle the AT_WAR and WAR relation bits both ways ; sign_treaty sets the TREATY bit, makes peace, and sets a cooldown = treaty_cooldown(turn)
formulas.note: Bit-flag relationship bookkeeping between the 4 powers.
formulas.title: Relationship state transitions

formulas.expr: restrained = (attitude >> 2 > demand_score) and (demand_score > 12) and (rng(0,4) != 0) ; the AI acts = not restrained
formulas.note: Code-side nerve check: a calm, cautious AI sometimes backs down.
formulas.title: Whether an AI follows through on a demand

formulas.expr: level = University(0x0E)? 3 : College(0x0D)? 2 : Schoolhouse(0x0C)? 1 : 0
formulas.note: Building bits 12/13/14 of the colony building bitmap. The level is both the tier cap (a level-L school teaches only @JOB tiers <= L) and the faculty cap.
formulas.title: School level from buildings

formulas.expr: per teacher (expert building-worker, tier <= level, faculty capped at min(level, cap)): random student.teach += 1 ; graduate at 4 / 6 / 8 turns by the profession's @JOB school tier ; graduate learns the teacher's profession as an expert (counter reset)
formulas.note: Random student per @0x02DEC5; turns-to-graduate 4/6/8 @0x02DDB4/@0x02DE98/@0x02DE8E; tier >= 4 (Teacher, Colonist, dock classes) is not teachable. The EXE's criminal->servant->colonist promotion applies to dock classes this colony model does not carry -- the free-colonist learn-outright branch is the one modeled.
formulas.title: Per-turn teaching + graduation

formulas.expr: refused if criminal / already a master / village already taught ; else succeed iff random_int(1,1000) >= 200*difficulty + 100  (P = 90/70/50/30/10%) ; on success class = village skill, village latched
formulas.note: Learnable skills are the outdoors/gathering experts only (Farmer, the three Planters, Fur Trapper, Silver Miner, Fisherman, Scout); each village teaches once (+0x03 bit 0x02 latch @0x04A78A); grant site @0x04A782, roll @0x4A72C. Player command POST /api/native/learn; outcome text = the verbatim GAME.TXT @LEARN* record.
formulas.title: Native learning ("live among the Indians")

formulas.expr: work += 1 per held turn ; threshold = terrain_move[t] + (clear/plow ? 2 : 0) ; Hardy Pioneer (class 0x14): threshold >>= 1 ; complete at work >= threshold (counter resets, order clears)
formulas.note: Counter +0x16 (@0x04071D/@0x040A46); +2 for clear/plow @0x040727, none for road @0x040A50; the halve is sar ax,1 @0x04074A/@0x040A59. The per-terrain basis is read as the terrain movement column (the stride-16 @TERRAIN row).
formulas.title: Improvement work counter + completion

formulas.expr: clear (forested): terrain id -= 8 (drops to the unforested base) + lumber to the adjacent own colony ; plow: improvement bit 0x40 ; road: improvement bit 0x08
formulas.note: Tile writes @0x040896 / @0x04089F / @0x040AEC; the lumber grant (@0x04084D, the +0xA4 Lumber slot) uses a @TERRAIN column not decoded numerically -> cfg.clear_lumber_base (RECONSTRUCTED). Clearing changes future yields byte-faithfully: the tile becomes its unforested base and the production model reads the new id.
formulas.title: Tile effects on completion

formulas.expr: tools -= 20 per completed action ; if tools < 20: tools = 0 and the Pioneer reverts to a plain Colonist
formulas.note: func_040608: sub 0x14 @0x4060F, the < 20 check @0x040614, reversion writes @0x04061D/@0x040621 (@USEDUPTOOLS). Tools live at UnitRecord +0x15, init 100.
formulas.title: Tool debit + pioneer reversion

formulas.expr: Scout: 2 ; Galleon/Privateer/Frigate: 2 ; any naval with Hernando de Soto (FF 7): 2 ; else 1  (a (2R+1)x(2R+1) square)

formulas.note: The visibility layer is separate from the .MP terrain byte (the EXE's 4th map layer); no shared exploration -- rivals are seen only inside your own revealed tiles. Colony reveal = func_0063B6.

formulas.expr: 4-option dialog (func_05A20E): Meet With Mayor (blocked during the WoI, test [0x5382],1 -> @NOMAYORSDURINGREV) / Infiltrate: success iff random_int(1,36) <= (X+6)*2, roll HALVED for a Seasoned Scout (sar @0x5A2F2), threshold +(diff-2) vs a human target / Attack -> func_05A40E with the Jan de Witt FF#4 info gate @0x5A469 / Nothing
formulas.note: Success reveals the colony square + bumps the target's +0xAA store by 100; failure loses the scout (@0x5A3EA, @LOSTOURSCOUTS) and its mounts go to the stables (@LOSTTHEIRSCOUTS '%NUMBER0 horses' -- count RECONSTRUCTED as 50). X in the threshold is unnamed in the disasm -- RECONSTRUCTED as the game difficulty.

formulas.expr: n = random_int(1,9) used DIRECTLY as the @LOSTCITY<n> suffix ; scout level s = Scout(+1) + Seasoned 0x16(+1) + de Soto(+1) ; bad outcomes (5 vanish / 8 shrines) escape-reroll via random_int(1, s+1) ; de Soto forces positive
formulas.note: No weight table -- the itoa-append @0x618D1 builds the key. Rumor PRESENCE is PROCEDURAL (func_006188, EXE-verified): ((x>>2)*0x13 + (y>>2)*0x11 + seed + 8) & 0x1F - (y&3)*4 == (x&3), seed = random_int(0,0x7fff) stored by the map generator (@0x64A23), gated on terrain (no Arctic/Ocean/Sea Lane) and a clean feature state; entering consumes the site (the stored state suppresses). Marker art = PHYS0 frame 103.

formulas.expr: ruins: gold = 10*(3d8) * (s+2)/2 ; Cibola: treasure = (10*(s+2) + 1d20) * 100 ; tribe gift: 2*(4d10) ; burial: empty / 10*(3d8) gold / 2*(1d8+2*(s+5))*100 treasure ; Fountain of Youth: 8 immigrants ; vanish: unit destroyed ; survivors: colonist joins
formulas.note: Dice sites @0x61776..@0x61A75; %NUMBER1 = value*100 (@0x618B1, the treasure stores gross/100); treasury credit @0x61C4C. Messages are the verbatim GAME.TXT @LOSTCITY1..9 / @BURIAL1..3 records with the %NUMBER fills, shown as turn notices.

formulas.expr: order byte 2 (@ORDERS row 2 'Trade Route, T') -> func_041080 ; arrival test @0x41034: Europe (dest 0x3E7) = the sea-lane column, colony = its (X,Y) ; on arrival run the stop's unload+load lists, advance the stop cursor (unit +0x315B high nibble), write the next stop's (X,Y) into the GoTo cache (+0x314D/+0x314E)
formulas.note: Route table: seg 0x1B22, stride 0x4A, max 12 routes ([0x53A0] cap @0x610B5 -> @TRADEMANY), 4 stops/route, 6 goods per lane (nibble-packed +0x03..+0x05 LOAD / +0x06..+0x08 UNLOAD, lane split @0x060E83). Unit binding: +0x315B low nibble = route, high nibble = stop (func_0075D4/func_0075FE). Unload-before-load lane order is RECONSTRUCTED.
formulas.title: Per-turn route automation

formulas.expr: LOAD func_00B880: colony stockpile[good] -= qty (sub @0xB8A5, 100/hold cap) ; UNLOAD func_00B8D0: stockpile[good] += qty (add @0xB8F5) ; Europe (dest 0x3E7 @0x4119A): the generic market sell/buy path -- sale credits gold net of tax, tax accrues to the King's REF fund, volume rides the +0xFC trade accumulator; buy is untaxed
formulas.note: The Europe-side PowerRecord writes are scalar-only (REF +0x22 / tally +0x26 / gold via 0x181f:0xaba @0x032A82..0x032A9C); the good-volume market arrays ride the same accumulator path as a manual sale (market.md 3.1). Skip-if-unaffordable on the Europe buy is RECONSTRUCTED.

systems.name: Trade routes - automated cargo ferrying
